Class PlatformRecordPublisher

java.lang.Object
app.record.PlatformRecordPublisher
@Component @ConditionalOnProperty(name="app.events.enabled", havingValue="true", matchIfMissing=true) public class PlatformRecordPublisher extends Object
Publishes each PlatformRecord to the "platform-records" topic after the transaction that wrote the row.

The reporting service has no database connection: this topic and trade-events are its only sources. The message key is the record's type and id, ORDER_AUDIT:17, so every state of one row lands on the same partition in order and the topic can be compacted down to the latest state of each row. The body is the record as JSON with its type added.

Publishing can never change the outcome of the write it reports. Like TradeEventPublisher, this catches everything the send can throw synchronously and logs it, and logs an asynchronous failure in the completion callback. A record raised outside a transaction is sent at once.

Absent when app.events.enabled is false.
